Name: Gihon in Jerusalem
Description: The spring on Jerusalem's east side where Solomon was brought down on David's mule and anointed king, and whose upper watercourse Hezekiah later stopped and redirected to the west side of the city of David.
BiblicalSignificance: Gihon marks turning points of Jerusalem's kings: Solomon's anointing there secured David's throne, and Hezekiah's redirection of its waters prepared the city for siege.
